The '''Krenher sector''' was located in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and included the [[Hyabb system/Legends|Hyabb]] and [[Voon system/Legends|Voon systems]] as well as the [[Hyabb-Twith Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hyabb]] was involved in a [[Hyabb–Twith war|war]] against the neighboring planet [[Twith]] that lasted almost since the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|foundation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

That conflict was further exacerbated when, tens of [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later, the [[Nelori Marauders]] set up a [[Nelori stronghold|base]] on the planet [[Voon/Legends|Voon]], the location of which on the disputed Hyabb-Twith Corridor allowed them to carry out raids on nearby [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] without repercussions. Eventually, however, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] waged the [[Hyabb-Twith Campaigns]] against the Marauders that included fighting on Voon and ultimately saw the Marauders' defeat.

==Description==
The Krenher sector was a part of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. It contained the [[Hyabb system/Legends|Hyabb]] and [[Voon system/Legends|Voon systems]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which were linked by the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Hyabb-Twith Corridor]].<ref name="Corridor" />

==Locations==
[[File:HyabbVoon-TEA.png|thumb|right|300px|The Krenher sector systems of Hyabb and Voon]]
The Krenher [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] Hyabb and Voon [[Star system/Legends|systems]]<ref name="EAOC" /> contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Hyabb]]<ref name="CSWE Hyabb">{{CSWECite|II|69|Hyabb}}</ref> and [[Voon/Legends|Voon]], respectively,<ref name="TotJC" /> and the Hyabb-Twith Corridor also linked them to the<ref name="Corridor" /> neighboring<ref name="TotJC" /> [[Twith system/Legends|Twith system]].<ref name="Corridor" /> Hyabb and the planet [[Twith]] were at a state of continuous [[Hyabb–Twith war|war]] that had lasted nearly since the [[Galactic Constitution Conference|foundation]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="CSWE Hyabb" /> in [[25,053 BBY]].<ref name="SWTORE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The Hyabb-Twith Corridor consequently became a virtually empty no-man's-land region between the two heavily-armed worlds. Neither Hyabb or Twith dared to risk repercussions from the other by dispatching [[Patrol ship/Legends|patrol ships]] into the disputed zone, and the neighboring systems were also actively discouraged from entering that territory.<ref name="TotJC" /> By approximately [[17,000 BBY]], Hyabb had become a part of the Republic.<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Hyabb system/Legends|Hyabb system]]</ref>

The sector saw further troubles<ref name="TotJC" /> [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] before [[4050 BBY]],<ref name="4000 date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' establishes that the [[Nelori Marauders]] were defeated in the [[Hyabb-Twith Campaigns]] "[[Standard decade/Legends|decades]]" prior to [[Arca Jeth]] becoming a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]. In addition, ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' and ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'' both establish that Jeth had attained that rank by the [[Time/Legends|time]] he participated in the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|victory]] over the [[Lorell Raiders]]. Since ''[[Galaxy at War]]'' dates the defeat of the Lorell Raiders to approximately [[4050 BBY]], the Hyabb-Twith Campaigns must have occurred decades prior to that date.</ref> the band of warriors<ref name="CSWE Nelori">{{CSWECite|II|369|Nelori Marauders}}</ref> and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]<ref name="CSWE Dachat">{{CSWECite|I|160|Dachat}}</ref> known as the [[Nelori Marauders]] was driven off its [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Dachat]]. The Nelori Marauders took advantage of the tensions between Hyabb and Twith and established their new [[Nelori stronghold|main base]] on Voon. Since neither Hyabb or Twith could afford to risk taking any action against the bandits,<ref name="TotJC" /> the Nelori preyed upon the governments of both planets.<ref name="CSWE Dachat" />

Furthermore, the Nelori Marauders raided [[Starship/Legends|starships]] both on the Hyabb-Twith Corridor<ref name="CSWE Dachat" /> and in the nearby systems. When the Nelori sphere of control began to extend deeper into the Republic's territory, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched a task force of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] to eliminate the threat posed by the Marauders. Following a series of confrontations that were known as the [[Hyabb-Twith Campaigns]] and involved [[First battle of Voon|two]] [[Second battle of Voon|battles]] at Voon, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] were victorious over the Nelori, shattering the latter's sphere of influence.<ref name="TotJC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Krenher sector was first mentioned in the [[1998]] ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]]. In the book, however, the sector's name was a misspelling that built upon<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> a previous mention of [[Krenhner Sector Station]]<ref name="SoL">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref>&mdash;which ''Star Wars Encyclopedia'' similarly misspelled as "Krenher Sector Station."<ref name="SWE" /> The erroneous spelling of the sector's name was repeated in the [[2000]] book ''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''<ref name="Guide">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe, Third Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> before the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' ultimately established the Krenher sector and the Krenhner sector as two separate entities. In addition, the Online Companion placed the Krenher sector in grid square K-9.<ref name="EAOC" />
